pre_fit_revision: Before any fitting, the SEC D proxy was set to the later of SEC filing date and acceptance date in New York, because five saved metadata records disagree by one day; exhibit-first, equal-per-document character allocation makes truncation explicit. Validation rows repeating an event group in any training-row text are excluded. At least one event-present validation row is required to fit C.
designated_text_source: SEC accession filings for NVDA and MU (8-K, 10-Q, 10-K), including earnings exhibits archived under the same accession
excluded_text_sources: standalone mutable issuer IR pages without verified historical version
FOMC HTML statements without verified historical content version
Jin10 and moomoo historical news with unverified full-window coverage
source_scope_decision: The SEC accession source was chosen before validation outcomes. FOMC and standalone IR remain separate descriptive corpus branches because their historical content versions are not established.
label: next session open-to-close UP iff close > open; exact tie is DOWN
price_features: existing v3 six adjusted-close and volume features ending at label session t-2; pending read-only financial audit
decision_instant: label session t-1 regular US market open, 09:30 America/New_York
announcement_alignment: SEC date D is max(filing_date, acceptance_at converted to America/New_York); F is the first complete US regular session strictly after D; source becomes usable at the next session after F, at 09:30 ET; for label t its eligibility session must be no later than decision session t-1
announcement_alignment_role: retrospective conservative date proxy, not proven point-in-time receipt
coverage_rule: for each 20-session window, SEC_FILINGS monthly coverage must be COMPLETE for the symbol; unknown or failed coverage excludes the row, never zero news
version_rule: all included accession documents and exhibits need SEC_ARCHIVE_HASHED version status, full body, valid local SHA-256 and source URL
event_group_rule: deduplicate accession event_id; SEC earnings exhibits precede filing body, then document_id order; every document receives an equal share of the 20000 character group budget; per-document truncation is recorded
text_cleaning: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace; tokens are ASCII alphabetic words followed by zero or more ASCII alphanumerics, minimum length 2

model.B: existing six price-and-volume features with L2 logistic
model.C: same B features plus train-fitted TF-IDF and extra text features
model.selection: validation balanced accuracy, tie stronger regularization

common_sample: A, B and C fit and validate on identical label dates with qualified SEC coverage and document version; excluded dates are listed privately and summarized publicly
split_leakage_rule: exclude every validation row whose 20-session event_id list intersects any train-row event_id list
evaluation_role: repeat-use development validation; no independent predictive or trading conclusion
